newsitem.title: USA: CSCE coffee called to open 3.00 to 4.00 cts higher.
newsitem.headline: CSCE coffee called to open 3.00 to 4.00 cts higher.

text.p: Traders called CSCE arabica coffee futures to open 3.00 to 4.00 cents higher.
Wednesday, CSCE coffee futures raced to their highest level in nearly two and a half years, passing the $2 a lb mark as concerns over market tightness persisted.
Most-active May settled up 5.40 cents at 200.65 cents, while spot March went out at 219.75 cents, up 8.10 cents.
Wednesday's rally was also helped by a move to raise deposit margins on the spot March contract, traders said.
